record_type: RETROSPECTIVE SYNTHESIS of study work, not a contemporaneous randomized or preregistered tournament

Meaningful first useful delivery retaining the essential transformation

selection_policy.numeric_ranking: None; no invented weighted score or success probability.

economic_metric_convention: USD cumulative incremental net customer benefit over ten years after acquisition, integration and operating costs. Revenue, obtainable revenue, profit and valuation remain separate.

candidates.name: Reusable behavioral contracts for obsolete digital component families
candidates.need_and_beneficiary: Owners and makers of otherwise useful industrial equipment need replacement parts after a necessary digital component is discontinued. Small fleets can be stranded when reverse engineering and qualification cost exceeds the preserved equipment value.
candidates.binding_limitation: High component-specific nonrecurring engineering, original-behavior uncertainty, and physical qualification expense. Reusable code alone does not remove electrical, timing, or component-specific obligations.
candidates.candidate_emergence: Physical manufacturing screening suggested reclaiming productive assets rather than optimizing existing maintenance. Early prior-art search found both commercial drop-in replacement and formal FPGA retargeting, shifting the formulation from individual emulation to whether a family capability changes the minimum economical fleet size.
causal_chain: Useful machinery is stranded by an unavailable component
Per-device investigation and qualification exceed the value of small fleets
Test whether independently checked family contracts reduce incremental engineering for a new device
Construct behavioral models, replacement implementations, explicit timing/electrical envelopes and reusable proof/test structure
Small installed fleets obtain economically viable replacement supply
Buyer accepts a replacement engineering package with a clear bench-validation boundary
Reuse accepted family capability across additional devices and hardware targets when marginal validation and support are worthwhile
candidates.why_now: Frontier agents can help interpret specifications and generate implementations and checks; accessible FPGA toolchains and formal methods provide executable validation. The underlying technology is established; only a measured combination that lowers the economically viable fleet threshold could justify a new enabling claim.
candidates.indispensable_capability: Correct transfer across a previously unseen member of a component family, with independently checked behavioral equivalence and a complete accounting of remaining physical qualification.
candidates.strongest_conventional_challenger: Competent electronics engineers with the same specifications, existing HDL/IP, ordinary asset library, and commercial/open formal verification. Siemens already documents old-netlist/RTL/new-netlist equivalence. Direct substitute component plus microcontroller protocol translation must also be allowed.

first_commercial_milestone.buyer: An equipment OEM or remanufacturer with a named unavailable non-safety-critical digital part
first_commercial_milestone.deliverable: Synthesizable replacement or firmware/interposer design, behavioral simulator, independent reference cases, reset and error coverage, explicit pin/timing/electrical assumptions, manufacturing bill of materials and separate bench-test plan.
first_commercial_milestone.standalone_use: Engineering and procurement evaluation of a specific replacement; physical supply is a later separately accepted scope.
first_commercial_milestone.larger_capability_becomes_more_credible: Only if the second family member meets equivalent obligations at lower total incremental engineering cost than competent conventional reuse.
first_commercial_milestone.status: Not built or buyer accepted in this screen. No physical qualification claimed.

candidates.decisive_experiment: Freeze two genuinely related public-specification devices and independent reference behavior. Build and qualify the first digitally. On fresh second-device work compare competent baseline, ordinary library with identical assets, and proposed retained capability. Count specification interpretation, implementation, independent checking, corrections and target verification. Then require physical tests before claiming a qualified component.

billion_plus_threshold.metric: Cumulative incremental net customer benefit after acquisition, integration and operating costs
billion_plus_threshold.mechanism: Render genuinely uneconomic replacement cohorts economical through reusable validated families, preserving useful productive assets after replacement design, fabrication, qualification and support costs.
billion_plus_threshold.equation: sum over newly served fleets of net incremental customer benefit over 10 years >= USD1e9
billion_plus_threshold.illustrative_threshold_only: At USD100,000 verified cumulative net benefit per newly served fleet, 10,000 such fleets would be required over ten years. Neither value nor count is established.
billion_plus_threshold.addressable_revenue: Unknown; value does not equal price.
billion_plus_threshold.obtainable_revenue: Unknown; zero observed in this study.
billion_plus_threshold.profit: Unknown; complete costs and paid orders unavailable.
billion_plus_threshold.admission_status: Not established. DLA examples establish substantial stakes but not this method's eligible population.
billion_plus_threshold.normalization_note: Retrospective common-metric normalization for the five-candidate tournament. Earlier exploratory annual-run-rate metrics remain preserved in discovery_physical.json; no demand, value or outcome observation changes.

candidates.name: Mechanical-response compiler for manufacturable lattice products
candidates.domain: Architected materials and physical product fabrication
candidates.need_and_beneficiary: Product manufacturers want spatially controlled stiffness, energy absorption and load response in devices such as inserts and protective structures, without expensive bespoke experimentation for every response profile.
candidates.binding_limitation: Simulation-to-fabrication discrepancy: printing, drainage, cleaning, material variation and loading change performance. Geometric generation is easier than reliable physical-response delivery.
candidates.candidate_emergence: The search connected inverse design with programmable material manufacture. Direct prior art showed autonomous physical closed-loop lattice discovery already exists, invalidating a generic AI-foundry formulation.
causal_chain: Need for custom physical response
Unreliable or costly translation from response to manufacturable geometry
Test design-family prediction against new fabricated targets
Construct calibrated response-to-geometry compiler with production envelope
Economical configurable mechanical products become possible
Deliver fabricated and measured insert meeting a frozen response envelope
Expand only to product/process families whose physical transfer is demonstrated
candidates.why_now: Public geometry and experimental datasets, mature parametric design, additive manufacturing and active-learning tooling make exploration accessible. However a nine-workstation automated physical discovery system is already reported, so availability does not imply a novel enabling capability.
candidates.indispensable_capability: A newly designed, actually fabricated geometry meets a fresh response target, with calibrated uncertainty and complete manufacturing cost.
candidates.strongest_conventional_challenger: Parametric search and Gaussian-process/multiobjective active learning using identical geometry families, physical tests and budget, including the ExMech construction where accessible.

first_commercial_milestone.deliverable: A fabricated and independently tested part, reproducible CAD and fabrication instructions, explicit material/process envelope and durability limitations.
first_commercial_milestone.standalone_use: A useful physical component accepted for a specified engineering use.
first_commercial_milestone.larger_capability_becomes_more_credible: Reliable translation from demanded response to a new manufacturable design.
first_commercial_milestone.status: Not executed; physical manufacture and fresh confirmation are unavailable in this screen.

candidates.name: Atmospheric measurement instrument from existing telecom attenuation
candidates.need_and_beneficiary: Water, drainage and meteorological operators lack dense local observations needed for operational decisions. Telecom network measurements could provide observations without installing a dedicated instrument at every location.
candidates.binding_limitation: Attenuation combines precipitation, wet antennas, baseline changes and quantization; severe weather can cause total signal loss. Inversion must distinguish these effects and quantify unavailable information.
candidates.candidate_emergence: The initial cross-domain connection was to extract drop-size distributions rather than only rainfall from dual-polarized links. A 2020 paper already implements this connection; public pycomlink also includes detection of gaps caused by heavy-rain signal loss.
causal_chain: Sparse local weather observations constrain operations
New dedicated sensors and maintenance are expensive
Test whether existing communications telemetry supports decision-relevant physical inference
Construct calibrated event-level inversion with failure and uncertainty treatment
Operational observation coverage in previously uninstrumented areas
Buyer uses a retrospective observation product for a specified decision
Licensed live network products expand only where calibration, data rights and buyer value support them
candidates.why_now: Year-long paired microwave/disdrometer/gauge data and open processing libraries are available, enabling rigorous retrospective tests now. This is accessible evidence, not a new invention: relevant measurement and processing methods are already published.
candidates.indispensable_capability: Decision-relevant physical observations beyond existing alternatives, with independently measured calibration and useful behavior through instrument artifacts and outages.
candidates.strongest_conventional_challenger: pycomlink/RAINLINK and published dual-polarization inversion under the same calibration data, holdout storms, climate split, raw telemetry and operating cost.

first_commercial_milestone.buyer: A drainage, hydrology or meteorological operator with an identified retrospective decision
first_commercial_milestone.deliverable: Event-level observation product with uncertainty, missingness and reference comparison, scoped to licensed data and an agreed decision.
first_commercial_milestone.standalone_use: Improved reconstruction of a real event for an actual operational analysis.
first_commercial_milestone.larger_capability_becomes_more_credible: Existing infrastructure provides an economically usable observation unavailable from conventional instruments at comparable complete cost.
first_commercial_milestone.status: No buyer or useful decision improvement observed; no live telemetry rights or delivery demonstrated.

Compare physics inversion, available open libraries and proposed method. Evaluate the buyer's decision, not just pointwise fit. A public-data reconstruction alone is insufficient for the flagship.

candidates.name: Deployment-specific recovery of legacy software capability
candidates.need_and_beneficiary: An operator or software producer may need a useful legacy function in a deployment that rejects the original implementation, such as an environment requiring memory-safe code. No specific unsolved beneficiary case was established in this study.
candidates.binding_limitation: Whole-codebase migration may exceed the value of the required function. A useful replacement must retain compatibility under real inputs and a specified deployment boundary, including malformed-input behavior and maintenance obligations.
candidates.candidate_emergence: The discovery screen reformulated general modernization as recovering only a needed deployable slice. Prior art on combined symbolic and model-assisted C-to-Rust translation then shifted the decisive question to a concrete counterexample that existing libraries and competent migration could not already satisfy.
causal_chain: A valuable legacy function cannot enter a required deployment
Whole-system migration or unsafe direct translation is too costly or inadmissible
Test whether a bounded function can be reconstructed with the required compatibility and deployment properties
Construct a runnable replacement slice plus an independent compatibility and malformed-input corpus
Existing applications can offer functionality in a previously inaccessible environment
A buyer accepts and runs the replacement library within a frozen responsibility envelope
Reuse interface families and verification assets across further unsolved deployment cases only when economical
candidates.why_now: Current public programs combine language-model synthesis, program analysis and equivalence work for automated migration. This documents available approaches and active development, not proof that the proposed specific deployment target is feasible or unserved.
candidates.indispensable_capability: A runnable replacement satisfies a real downstream deployment restriction while preserving the accepted function and complete responsibility at a cost below the best conventional solution.
candidates.strongest_conventional_challenger: A maintained native implementation, a competent engineer using existing translation and verification tools, or a redesigned interface that removes the need to migrate the original code. Each receives the same specification, inputs, resources and revised objective.

first_commercial_milestone.buyer: A software operator with a named blocked deployment and a budget for the specific recovered function
first_commercial_milestone.deliverable: Runnable replacement library, integration example, independent compatibility and malformed-input evidence, frozen acceptance and one explicit correction/support scope.
first_commercial_milestone.standalone_use: The buyer can deploy the specified function even if the larger venture stops.
first_commercial_milestone.larger_capability_becomes_more_credible: Only accepted delivery that crosses a previously binding deployment or economic boundary demonstrates the necessary capability.
first_commercial_milestone.status: Not constructed or accepted; no adequate unsolved target was identified.

candidates.decisive_experiment: Freeze a real public target, downstream API and deployment restriction. Give maintained alternatives and conventional migration equal information and resources. Require the complete replacement to execute representative and fresh cases, reject invalid inputs appropriately, and meet recipient-run acceptance. Count correction, integration and maintenance; do not substitute a toy parser.

billion_plus_threshold.metric: Cumulative incremental net customer benefit after acquisition, integration and operating costs
billion_plus_threshold.mechanism: Repeatedly enable valuable deployments that cannot economically use whole-system migration or maintained alternatives. Accumulating accepted interface families could lower the cost of subsequent genuinely blocked deployments.
billion_plus_threshold.equation: sum over newly enabled deployments of verified incremental net customer benefit over 10 years >= USD1e9
billion_plus_threshold.illustrative_threshold_only: USD100,000 verified cumulative net value per deployment would require 10,000 newly enabled deployments. Neither the average value nor the eligible count is established.
billion_plus_threshold.profit: Unknown after integration, validation, support and failures.
billion_plus_threshold.admission_status: Not established; no specific unresolved target or buyer acceptance.

candidates.name: Constructive manufacturing interoperability
candidates.domain: Digital product definition and downstream production transfer
candidates.need_and_beneficiary: A producer may lose useful design relationships or downstream information when a product changes tools or suppliers. A small manufacturer or CAD/CAM developer could benefit from a portable, executable representation, but the tested public tutorials do not establish such a commercial need.
candidates.binding_limitation: Moving nominal shape does not automatically preserve parameter relationships, product requirements or authority to release production. Repeated manual reconstruction may be costly; whether it is necessary is itself testable.
candidates.candidate_emergence: The initial construction sought a portable executable production package. NIST historical missing-model language was investigated, then rejected as evidence of a current gap. Direct editing removed the supposed universal need to recover history. The surviving build was explicitly reduced to conventional nominal-feature support and was not admitted as the transformational milestone.
causal_chain: Design/tool/supplier transfer blocks or overprices a useful job
Executable production meaning is lost or cannot be reproduced at viable cost
Test whether portable constructive representation changes the recipient outcome or minimum economical job size
Construct source-bound geometry with supplied relationships, requirements and authorized acceptance
A recipient can create and revise an accepted artifact for a previously rejected job
A buyer accepts a useful transfer under a frozen scope and price
Reuse accepted transfer families across qualified tools and suppliers when complete costs justify it
candidates.why_now: Executable CAD scripting, current frontier-assisted code construction, geometric kernels, semantic PMI and open reference data make a bounded construction accessible. Direct modeling, CAD-Recode and established feature-recognition systems also already supply much of the proposed mechanism. Availability is not a surviving novelty or commercial-gap result.
candidates.indispensable_capability: Preserve enough supplied geometry, relationships, requirements and recipient acceptance to enable a real transfer the strongest conventional route cannot already supply economically.
candidates.strongest_conventional_challenger: The original free parameterized CadQuery programs; competent direct/synchronous editing that avoids history recovery; ordinary scripted CAD and feature recognition with the same reusable asset and revised objective. No price is assigned to an impossible human reconstruction.

first_commercial_milestone.buyer: Proposed CAD/CAM developer or producer with an authorized, explicitly specified transfer problem; no buyer obtained
first_commercial_milestone.deliverable: Proposed source-bound nominal conformance/test package with explicitly supplied variants, independent digital checks and recipient-run acceptance. Material, manufacturing tolerance, machine release and recovered dependency claims remain outside scope.
first_commercial_milestone.standalone_use: A developer can inspect and reuse the conventional test artifact. This is plausible usefulness, not observed willingness to pay.
first_commercial_milestone.larger_capability_becomes_more_credible: Only a useful accepted transfer that changes feasibility relative to the strongest conventional alternative could support the enterprise. Current construction does not establish this.
first_commercial_milestone.status: Supporting artifact constructed; commercial milestone and essential transformation not demonstrated.
first_commercial_milestone.terms_status: Proposed, unvalidated and not offered to a customer.

constructed_scope.historical_inputs: Three public educational CadQuery scripts manually interpreted by an assistant, not customer STEP parts.
constructed_scope.output: Explicit nominal feature recipes; generated valid solids; STEP, visualization STL/SVG, nominal CSV tables; frozen references and replay.
constructed_scope.fresh_inputs: Three new researcher-specified feature requests after constructor freeze.
essential_missing_properties: Original parameter relationships are not preserved
Missing physical units and production requirements are not inferred
No physical production or buyer acceptance
No lower minimum economical job size demonstrated
constructed_scope.milestone_test_A: Artifact remains usable if venture stops; commercially useful buyer outcome unobserved.
constructed_scope.milestone_test_B: Not met. Native source already performs the central construction and preserves more parameter relationships.

candidates.decisive_experiment: For a future candidate, freeze a real buyer-defined change contract and supplied requirements; compare accepted output and complete cost to direct editing, native source and ordinary scripted CAD. Test actual parameter relations and fresh recipient use. The current educational construction tests only nominal geometry and cannot substitute for that experiment.

billion_plus_threshold.metric: Cumulative incremental NET CUSTOMER BENEFIT after service price and buyer integration
billion_plus_threshold.mechanism: Repeated accepted production transfers would make formerly rejected jobs viable, if an actual advantage over available CAD tools and free source were established.
billion_plus_threshold.equation: accepted newly enabled outcomes over 10 years * verified net customer benefit per outcome >= USD1e9
billion_plus_threshold.illustrative_threshold_only: At the unvalidated USD250 net customer benefit assumption, 4,000,000 accepted outcomes are needed. The frozen establishment/adoption/job assumptions produce only USD98,258,175 and require about 203.55 jobs per active shop-year to reach the target. These are arithmetic requirements, not demand forecasts.
billion_plus_threshold.customer_value: Unvalidated USD250-per-outcome assumption in a separate scale model.
billion_plus_threshold.addressable_revenue: Not inferred from establishment count or manufacturing TAM.
billion_plus_threshold.obtainable_revenue: Not estimated beyond the finite hypothetical cohort.
billion_plus_threshold.conditional_revenue_warning: 4,000,000 hypothetical accepted outcomes times USD1,200. This is neither addressable nor obtainable revenue.
billion_plus_threshold.profit: Unknown at expansion scale; finite conditional provider scenarios are separate.
billion_plus_threshold.admission_status: FAIL: no eligible population, adoption, increment in value or commercial threshold shift validated.

Unknown physical units, materials and tolerances
commercial: A real constraint not solved by native source or direct editing
Complete correction, support and customer-specific integration cost
financing: Unknown insurance/licensing obligations beyond the finite digital scope

stopping_criteria: Reject flagship when ordinary free source supplies the tested outcome.
Reject preserved-design-intent claims when nominal extraction drops parameter relationships.
Do not turn source tutorials into industrial purchase-order evidence.
Do not equate geometry acceptance with process or physical acceptance.
Stop new venture construction until a real buyer-defined constraint survives the conventional challenger.
